diagnosis.summary: Both order-service and payment-service are in a severe error state. Payment-service is returning 5xx errors on 73.2% of requests and its p95 latency has risen from 4.5 ms to 3633.7 ms, a rise of roughly 807x. Order-service, which calls payment-service on every order, is seeing 36.7% 5xx errors and p95 latency up from 25.1 ms to 3648.8 ms, with 90 dependency errors per minute.
diagnosis.root_cause: A failure within the payment-service handler is the most likely root cause, with payment-service itself returning errors and extremely high latency that is reflected almost identically in order-service's dependency call times.
evidence: Payment-service 5xx error rate is at 73.2%, up from a baseline of 0.
Payment-service p95 latency rose from 4.5 ms to 3633.7 ms, approximately 807x its baseline.
Order-service recorded 90 dependency errors per minute against payment-service, up from a baseline of 0.
Order-service dependency p95 latency rose from 22.1 ms to 3648.1 ms (roughly 165x baseline), closely matching payment-service's own p95 latency of 3633.7 ms.
Order-service 5xx error rate is at 36.7%, up from a baseline of 0, and its p95 latency rose from 25.1 ms to 3648.8 ms, approximately 145x its baseline.
Payment-service mean Lambda handler duration rose from 0.59 ms to 2.23 ms, roughly 3.8x its baseline.
recommended_actions: Inspect payment-service CloudWatch Logs at /aws/lambda/anomalypulse-payment for errors, exceptions, or timeout signals in the handler to identify what is failing inside Payment.
Check payment-service lambda_throttle_count in CloudWatch to determine whether Lambda throttling is contributing to the dependency_error_count in order-service.

Compare dependency_latency_ms_p95 on order-service against payment-service p95_latency_ms; they are nearly identical at roughly 3648 ms, so investigate whether calls are approaching or hitting the read timeout on order-service's call to payment-service.
Once the root failure in payment-service is identified and fixed, verify that order-service dependency_error_count and error_rate_5xx return to baseline before closing the incident.
Do not add retries to order-service's call to payment-service while payment-service is struggling, as each retry would add additional invocations and further increase latency exposure.
